title: Cat Sits on Sleeping Pig's Back
description:
Ernest, the cat, loved to play with this pig. So, while they were asleep, he sat on their back. He tried to catch a fly that was hovering over the pig and licked their back along with his paws. Being the mayor of the farm, the cat took care of his friend.
